desc: Derive per-prime reduction: |e_i - e_{i+1}| = v_p(A_i) for each edge, min_i e_i = 0 for the gcd condition, and answer = product over primes p of W_p where W_p sums p^{sum e_i} over valid height walks touching zero.
Prove primes are independent and that heights touching zero are bounded by S_p = sum_i v_p(A_i), so the DP state space is finite.

Implement the prime-wise (height, seen_zero) DP: factorize A_i, build exponent arrays, bound heights by S_p, init position 1 with weight p^h, transition h -> h ± d_i, multiply by p^{new height}, sum states with seen_zero true.
Multiply per-prime W_p results modulo 998244353 (absent primes give factor 1) and output the final answer.
Test the implementation against all three provided samples (expected 939634344, 18, 192457116) and fix any discrepancies.
